name: Puter
short: Cloud OS with an AI gateway: 500+ models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Mistral and more via Puter.js, with a free account tier and a user-pays billing model where the app's end user covers AI costs.

plans.name: Free tier
plans.notes: Free account with 25 MB storage and limited AI & Cloud access.

plans.name: User-Pays model
plans.notes: Apps built on Puter.js pass AI usage costs to the signed-in end user's own Puter account instead of the developer's.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: 100 GB storage with expanded AI & Cloud access.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: 500 GB storage with advanced AI & Cloud access.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 2 TB storage with maximum AI & Cloud access.

plans.name: Free model ids
plans.notes: Selected catalog ids bill $0 per 1M tokens (e.g. Recursive Flint, MiniMax M3.1 Flash, Fireworks Ember-1).
